description: Estimates the US federal capital gains exclusion for qualified small business stock under IRC Section 1202, including the July 2025 changes (tiered 3, 4 and 5 year exclusions and the $15M cap for stock acquired after July 4, 2025). Assumes the stock otherwise qualifies. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/qsbs-calculator

basis_usd.description: Adjusted basis of the shares sold.

prior_gain_usd.description: Gain from the same company already excluded in earlier years.

sold_date.description: Date the stock is or will be sold (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: qsbs
title: QSBS (Section 1202) calculator
